predecessors.name: Akkadian Empire
predecessors.text: Lagash, Girsu and Nina, under Akkadian governors (Lugal-ushumgal under Naram-Sin, Puzur-Mama under Shar-kali-sharri) until Puzur-Mama 'declared Lagash independent'

successors.name: Third Dynasty of Ur
successors.text: 'He slew Nam-ha-ni the ensi of Lagash' (Code of Ur-Nammu); Lagash became 'the largest and most prosperous province of the empire'

ledger.x: 2164 BCE: Ur-Baba opens the Second Dynasty of Lagash.
2110 BCE: Ur-Nammu of Ur takes Lagash.

wars.name: Gudea's campaign against Anshan and Elam
wars.outcome: 'Although Gudea claimed to have conquered Elam and Anshan'; 'the main military exploit seems to have occurred in his Year 6' (c.

wars.name: Ur-Nammu's conquest of Lagash
wars.outcome: Nam-mahani slain; Lagash annexed as a province of Ur.

certainty.note: A city territory of three towns; no line on any page.
